# Backend fixtures

`sample_invoice.txt` is a small, non-sensitive logistics fixture retained from the original
workspace for extraction and classification tests. The remaining workspace PDFs are kept out
of this repository until their licensing and test purpose are confirmed.

`invoice_with_logistics.txt` is a synthetic invoice created for API regression tests and
manual upload checks. All company names, addresses, and references are fictional. It
demonstrates line items, exact monetary values, currency, a due date, and shipment/PO fields.
